name: Thanuja Rameshbaabu
positioning: Computer Science & Applied Mathematics student building full-stack and AI products
bio:
I'm a student at **Vanderbilt University** majoring in **Computer Science and Applied Mathematics**, with a minor in **Engineering Management**.

I build full-stack web applications, from React and TypeScript front ends to Node.js and Python back ends, with a focus on practical applications of AI. I work spec-first: I define what a feature must do and why before writing code, which keeps projects focused, testable and easy to extend.

My long-term goal is to lead engineering teams that build reliable, well-designed products. Studying engineering management alongside computer science and mathematics prepares me to pair strong technical skills with sound planning and collaboration.
currentFocus: Building AI-assisted web apps and looking for software engineering internships.
